summary: Native Android release 0.5.25 (versionCode 27): the next Play build after 0.5.24. Adds what merged after 0.5.24: Settle on the phones (#523, #511), Snooze and shared presets (#518, #522), the Details sheet (#519), the WebView renderer recovery for chat visuals (#480), and, behind flags that stay off, hub children (#521, hub_children and hub_remote_children) and live pages (#491, phone_html_live_run).

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts of each shipped feature are covered by that feature's own manifest.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own OTA and build lanes; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API change; the backend contracts these Android features use are covered by their own manifests.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump.

automated: The mobile-release workflow runs the Android unit, lint and androidTest compile gate before it builds the AAB.
notExercised: Install of the Play internal build on the OnePlus 11R (next step, by the user).
